desc: The SOG FastHawk is faster, lighter, more agile, and easier to carry than its sibling the Tactical Tomahawk. The 420 stainless steel head with a Hard cased black coating is mounted to the ballistic polymer handle with heavy-duty bolts and a steel ferrule to insure the strongest integrity. Side hammer checkering insures precision placement when swinging. Carried in a nylon sheath that can be mounted to belt, backpack, or gear. It is a universal tool for modern man. Blade Length 2" x.26" Overall Length 12.5" Weight 19 oz. Edge Straight.
